name: What types of tile are best for high-traffic areas like kitchens and entryways?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best for high-traffic areas like kitchens and entryways?

acceptedAnswer.text: For high-traffic areas such as kitchens, entryways, and hallways, durable and resistant tile types are recommended. Porcelain tile is an excellent choice due to its high density, low porosity, and exceptional resistance to scratches, chips, and moisture. Ceramic tile with a high PEI (Porcelain Enamel Institute) rating also offers good durability. Natural stone options like granite or slate can withstand heavy use but may require more maintenance. We can help you select the best option based on your home's specific needs and aesthetic preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is highly recommended for high-traffic areas due to its durability and resistance. High PEI rated ceramic and some natural stones are also good options.
